issues.title: No test covers draining a frame queued just before _stream_closing is set
issues.verdictReason: The new test only calls send_empty_frame() after close_entered is true, i.e. after _stream_closing is already set, so it exercises the immediate-refusal path in connection::send() (rpc.cc:291) but never a frame that was accepted into _outgoing_queue before the flag flipped; removing the queue_drained wait before write_buf.close() (rpc.cc:562-571) would not fail the test.
issues.scopeReason: The untested path is the queue-drain half of the fix this PR adds in stream_close().

issues.title: New docs overstate that reading-until-throw always closes the source
issues.verdictReason: In source_impl::operator()() (rpc_impl.hh:941-983), close_source() is only invoked from the then_wrapped handler around con->stream_receive(), i.e. on a network-level failure or eof; if unmarshall() throws synchronously while decoding a buffer (process_one_buffer, rpc_impl.hh:942-949), that exception propagates straight out without close_source() ever running, so _source_closed (rpc.hh:301/356-357) stays false even though the application's read loop did stop on a throw as the doc describes.
issues.scopeReason: The "Closing a stream" section making this claim is new text added by this PR.

issues.title: put(std::span) test sink override lacks SEASTAR_API_LEVEL guard
issues.verdictReason: data_sink_impl::put(std::span<...>) is only the pure virtual under SEASTAR_API_LEVEL >= 9 (iostream.hh:109-127); below that, put(net::packet) is required instead. test_data_sink_impl::put at rpc_test.cc:1883 has no #if guard, unlike the great majority of data_sink_impl overrides in the tree (loopback_socket.hh:144, metrics_perf.cc:65, src/net/posix-stack.cc:869, etc.), so building with -DSeastar_API_LEVEL=7 (still a supported CMake cache value) would fail to compile this test file.
issues.scopeReason: New test-only class added by this PR; the default build (API level 9) is unaffected but the alternate configuration the project still exposes is broken by this new code.

issues.title: New comment misdescribes when _outgoing_queue_ready becomes exceptional
issues.verdictReason: In connection::send()'s continuation (rpc.cc:329-338), a failed send_entry() calls abort() and then p->done.set_value() (not set_exception), so a failed entry resolves _outgoing_queue_ready with a value, not an exception; it only becomes exceptional via withdraw()/negotiation-abort paths (rpc.cc:215, 264-266), as the pre-existing comment at rpc.cc:226 correctly says, contradicting the new comment's "exceptional if an entry failed" wording.
issues.scopeReason: The comment is new text added by this PR's stream_close() change.

issues.title: Comment overstates that yield() itself runs the batch flush poller
issues.verdictReason: yield() (reactor.cc:5008-5013) only schedules a no-op task and returns its future; it does not call poll_once()/the batch_flush_pollfn (reactor.cc:2909-2945) itself, so "let the batch flush poller run" conflates the scheduling round-trips a blocking yield().get() causes with yield() directly driving reactor polling.

issues.title: Comment describing what still waits on _outgoing_queue_ready
issues.verdictReason: The comment is accurate: once _stream_closing is set, connection::send() refuses immediately (rpc.cc:291) rather than chaining onto _outgoing_queue_ready, and stream_close() resets _outgoing_queue_ready to a ready future via std::exchange (rpc.cc:562) before stop_send_loop() runs, so stop_send_loop()'s when_all (rpc.cc:225) effectively only waits on _sink_closed_future by that point, matching what the comment claims.
issues.scopeReason: N/A — not a real defect, but the commented code is new in this PR.

issues.title: _stream_closing alleged to duplicate state already tracked by _error
issues.verdictReason: _stream_closing and _error are not redundant: stream_close() sets _stream_closing = true before closing the write buffer, while _error is only set later inside stop() (via stop_send_loop, rpc.cc:198); the flag exists precisely to cover the window where sends must be refused but _error is still false.
issues.scopeReason: N/A — not a real defect; _stream_closing is new state added by this PR.
